## Install

1. Download **Shotshelf-*.dmg** below and open it.
2. Drag **Shotshelf** onto **Applications**.
3. Open Shotshelf from Applications.

Shotshelf is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later, on Apple silicon or Intel. It reads your screenshots on your Mac and never connects to the internet.

### First launch

The welcome window asks where your screenshots should live, whether to move the ones already on your Desktop, and (optionally) where your code projects are. Nothing is read or moved until you click **Get Started**. macOS may then ask to let Shotshelf use your Desktop or Documents folder, and to send notifications. Allow them so sorting works in the background.
